summary_1line: Duryodhana pressures Bhishma to kill the Pandavas; Bhishma rebukes him, praises Arjuna’s invincibility with Krishna, and vows to fight fiercely but never strike Sikhandin.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma, wounded by harsh words, raises his blazing eyes toward Duryodhana like an enraged serpent while the war camp burns with torchlight.
Duryodhana stands with folded hands and tearful eyes before the aged Bhishma seated on a golden seat in his war pavilion.
Bhishma solemnly declares he will not shoot arrows at Sikhandin, recalling her past as a woman while warriors listen in tense silence.
